name: form-item
summary: The form field: label + validation + control + error/help. MValidationProvider (vee-validate) -> MFormItem. Most-used component (1783x). required is derived from rules.

rules.note: vee-validate rules e.g. required|email|max:255; REQUIRED ASTERISK is derived from this (F1)

infoTooltip.note: (i) icon by the label with hover help (HTML allowed)

type.note: control type for the built-in MInput (text/number/textarea/...)

inputType.note: overrides type for the built-in MInput

immediate.note: validate on mount (red border; message still pristine-gated, F2)

anatomy: label (+ required asterisk + optional info tooltip)
help text OR error message (red when invalid)

behaviors.required: asterisk shown when rules include 'required' (not required_if)
behaviors.validation: eager mode validates on interaction; error => red border + inline errors[0]; message is pristine-gated (shows after interaction, border shows immediately)
behaviors.control: no slot => built-in MInput (routed by type); slot => any control with label+validation

accessibility.label: associated with the control via MFormItem
accessibility.required: asterisk is visual; the rule/error conveys requirement to AT
accessibility.focus: inner controls have no visible ring (SF-001)

decisionFlow: Building a form field (label + control + validation)? -> FlotoFormItem (always).
Plain text/number/textarea control? -> omit the slot, set type (built-in MInput).
Select / Radio / Checkbox / picker / tag input? -> put it in the default slot.
Needs validation? -> set rules (required|email|max:255 ...); required asterisk is automatic.
Need a persistent hint? -> help. Longer explanation? -> info-tooltip.

field(default).useWhen: any labelled form field; omit slot for a built-in MInput

required.must: put 'required' in rules (asterisk derives from it) — there is no required prop (F1)

custom-control.useWhen: the control is not a plain input (Select/Radio/Checkbox/picker/LooseTags)
custom-control.example: Severity as a segmented MRadioGroup in the slot

help.useWhen: a short persistent hint under the field
help.example: In seconds. Lower values increase load.

info-tooltip.useWhen: a longer explanation behind an (i) icon (MTooltip/VTippy, hover)
info-tooltip.note: needs vue-tippy VTippy registered (done in SB preview)

validation.note: rules from src/validations.js; error = red border + message (pristine-gated)

layout.useWhen: vertical (label on top) for narrow/focused forms — drawers, modals, integration setup (Slack/Jira/ServiceNow), pickers; horizontal (label beside) for dense settings pages — Mail Server, Proxy, SNMP Trap, RADIUS, 2FA, My Profile
layout.note: set on the parent FlotoForm/MForm layout; drawers/modals -> vertical, full settings pages -> horizontal

text.useWhen: The field collects a short single-line string. Omit the default slot and set type="text" (or leave type default) so FlotoFormItem renders its own built-in MInput; the wrapper still supplies label + validation + help/error.
text.dontUse: Don't use for non-text controls (Select/Radio/Checkbox/picker/tag input — put those in the default slot), for multi-line prose (use textarea), or for numeric-only entry with steppers (use number).
text.example: The 'Monitor name' / 'Name' text field on almost every create form, or 'Community String' on the SNMP settings form.

number.useWhen: The field collects a numeric value; set type="number" so the built-in MInput renders a number control. Pair with numeric rules like rules="required|numeric|min_value:1".
number.dontUse: Don't use for free-form text (use text) or for a value chosen from a fixed set (use custom-control with a radio/picker). Don't hand-roll min/max — express it in rules.
number.example: The 'Polling Interval' field (with help 'In seconds. Lower values increase load.'), or 'Hours' / 'Threshold Counter' fields on create forms.

textarea.useWhen: The field collects multi-line text — descriptions, notes, messages, scripts. Set type="textarea" so the built-in MInput renders a multi-line box; the wrapper still gives label + validation.
textarea.dontUse: Don't use for single-line strings (use text) or numbers (use number). Don't reach for a custom slot control — textarea is built in via type.
textarea.example: A 'Description' field on a Group / profile create form, or a multi-line note on an integration setup panel.

vertical.useWhen: Space is narrow or the flow is focused — drawers, modals, wizards, setup panels, and forms with long labels. Label stacks above a full-width control. Set layout="vertical" on the parent FlotoForm/MForm. When unsure, vertical is the safe default (works at any width).
vertical.dontUse: Don't use for a dense settings page with many short fields where label-to-value column alignment matters — that reads better horizontal.
vertical.example: The Add/Edit drawers and integration setup forms — Slack, MS Teams, Jira, ServiceNow.

horizontal.useWhen: A dense settings page with many short fields scanned top-to-bottom, where label-to-value alignment matters. Label sits in a left column, control to the right (tune with labelCol/wrapperCol). Set layout="horizontal" on the parent FlotoForm/MForm.
horizontal.dontUse: Don't use in narrow containers like drawers/modals/wizards or with long labels — the two-column layout cramps; use vertical there.
horizontal.example: Mail Server, Proxy, SNMP Trap, RADIUS, Two-Factor Auth, and My Profile settings pages.

notCovered.is-view: lives on the inner controls, not FlotoFormItem
notCovered.repeatable: multiple-form-items is a separate related component

do: Wrap every form control in FlotoFormItem for consistent label + validation + error.
Put validation in rules; add reusable rules in src/validations.js.
Use the default slot for non-text controls; help for hints, info-tooltip for longer guidance.
dont: Don't pass a 'required' attribute — put required in rules (F1).
Don't hand-roll labels/validation around a bare input.
Don't rely on @input — v-model uses update.
whenToUse: Every labelled, validated field in a form.
insteadOf: a bare input with a hand-made label + validation
knownIssues: F1 (low): required is derived from rules (regex for 'required'); there is no required prop — passing required does nothing. A convenience prop could help.
F2 (low): error message is pristine-gated — with immediate the red border shows but the message only appears after interaction (expected vee-validate behavior).
F3 (high, a11y): inner controls have no visible focus ring (SF-001).
changelog: 2026-06-07: added (decision-grade) — the Form Field molecule (1783x). vee-validate provider -> MFormItem; required derived from rules; built-in MInput vs slot control; help + info-tooltip; validate/setValue/addError/focus. SB preview registers MValidationProvider/Observer + src/validations + FlotoFormItem. Verified live email error + red border. F1-F3.

FlotoForm.what: the form WRAPPER (MValidationObserver + MForm). Wrap FlotoFormItems in it.

props.showNotification: Boolean (default false) — toast on failed validate

methods.validate(): Promise<true|reject> — call via ref before manual submit

FlotoForm.slots: pass-through; default/named slots receive { validate, submit, reset }

a11y.summary: Label associated via MFormItem (click focuses the control). Errors are text (not colour-only), pristine-gated; the required asterisk is visual — keep the required rule.
issues: Wrapped controls have no visible focus ring (SF-001).
info-tooltip content sits behind a hover trigger.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
